derivation: Simple Tools sells only the empty Enderite bucket (WH26-7: row and exclusions moved from Simple Crucibles, the price is unchanged; filled buckets are never traded): the Death Vault is a crafted block, the Soulbound book comes only from the wandering trader (diamonds) and End City loot (owner 2026-10-12). Money bills count as Death Vault offerings through the optional tag simpletools:death_vault_offerings.

excluded.simpletools:biome_brush: Crafted from Nether Stars or the Nether Heart boss drop; not for sale.
excluded.simpletools:death_vault: Crafted only (KONZEPT-DEATH-VAULT, owner 2026-10-12); bills are accepted as offerings instead.
excluded.simpletools:enderite_lava_bucket: Filled bucket; buy the empty one.
excluded.simpletools:enderite_lava_bucket_full: Filled bucket (two buckets); buy the empty one.
excluded.simpletools:enderite_milk_bucket: Filled bucket (milked); buy the empty one.
excluded.simpletools:enderite_milk_bucket_full: Filled bucket (two buckets); buy the empty one.
excluded.simpletools:enderite_soul_lava_bucket: Filled only by scooping soul lava; no trade.
excluded.simpletools:enderite_soul_lava_bucket_fu: Filled only by scooping soul lava twice; no trade.
excluded.simpletools:enderite_water_bucket: Filled bucket; buy the empty one.
excluded.simpletools:enderite_water_bucket_full: Filled bucket (two buckets); buy the empty one.
excluded.simpletools:guide_book: Crafted from a book and an anvil.
excluded.simpletools:strip_station: Crafted only (IG31-59): 4 iron bars, 4 planks and an iron axe; not for sale.
